name: Trung Khanh chestnut
summary: Trùng Khánh chestnut is an autumn nut with a dark glossy shell and a yellow kernel. Roasted, Báo Cao Bằng calls it nutty, sweet, and aromatic. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Trung Khanh, on the eastern road.
howToEat: Eat it roasted or boiled. The 22 March 2023 article describes an even, nearly round nut, a dark glossy shell, and a yellow kernel. The same nut goes into chestnut green rice, ham hock, and chestnut wine.
A harvest month and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Trung Khanh and the eastern road, in autumn. The 1 September 2026 article also lists the nut as a gift to carry home.
